description: Default capability - least privilege. The engine is not wired yet, so only the plugin default permission sets needed by the shell are granted. Tighten `fs` scopes when engine IPC lands. Note: `single-instance` is intentionally absent - it is a Rust-only plugin with no frontend commands, so it needs no capability entry. fs:allow-write-text-file is scoped to $DOWNLOAD/* for user-triggered exports only (Leader tin 5907).
